description: One table of cases for every reader (schema 9.7.0): the progress bar and the progress ring. Rules: x-style.layout.progress; policy rows unknownToken, tokenWithoutFieldDefault, unorderedGradient. Numbers are logical pixels under the theme below (the spacing and the «pill» radius are the values of the built-in theme; the gradients are declared for this table). «readerOnly» — a value the builder does not produce or does not publish (an unknown word, a token the theme does not declare, a wrong form); a reader still has to draw it this way. Angles are degrees clockwise from the top of the ring.

ratioCases.name: the limit is not 100: three of four
value equal to the limit: the whole scale
value over the limit is clamped to the whole scale
negative value is clamped to nothing
limit 0 is NO scale, not a full one
negative limit with a negative value is still no scale (not 0.5)
no value in the data (null): nothing is filled
no limit in the data (null): no scale
a value that is a string is not a number

ringCases.name: size sm, no style: two units
size md, no style: three units
size lg, no style: four units
unknown size word (a newer minor): md
no size field: md
style.width names the diameter; the height follows it
style.height names the diameter; the width follows it
style is stronger than the size word
wide box: the diameter is the smaller side, the ring is centred along the row
tall box: the diameter is the smaller side, the ring is centred across the row
the size includes the padding: the diameter is the content side
the size includes the border
padding and border together
padding alone names nothing: the size word, and the box grows around it
a box smaller than its padding: no ring, the box stays
maxWidth caps the named width
minWidth alone names the side: the ring is not smaller than it
minWidth below the natural size changes nothing
maxWidth alone names the side: the ring is not larger than it
minWidth with a named smaller height: the height wins, the ring is centred
inverted range: the minimum wins
under a row weight the width fields do not name the diameter
under a row weight a named height still names the diameter
a fill layer of a stack: no field names the diameter
thickness by a token
thickness by a number
the thickness does not change the box: the arc is inside the circle
thickness equal to half of the diameter: a disc
thickness over half of the diameter is clamped to the half
zero thickness: nothing is drawn, the box stays
a big ring with a thick arc
348: a label in the middle does not enlarge the box: size md with a percent label is 72 × 72, not 72 × 77
348: the same with the label «value of max»

arcCases.name: a quarter, LTR: from the top to three o'clock
a quarter, RTL: the SAME arc, the ring is not mirrored

barCases.name: no thickness field: the token sm
RTL: the fill grows from the right
a fill narrower than the thickness: a narrow oval, the radius is half of its WIDTH
full scale: the fill is the track
the thickest bar: the radius is half of the thickness while it is under the pill token
a short thick track: the radius is half of the shorter side
zero thickness: no track and no fill
a token the theme does not declare: the default thickness
a thickness of a wrong form (a fraction): the default thickness

paintCases.name: no new fields: the scale as before 9.7.0
track color by a token
the white ring on a gradient: a 30% white track under a white fill
track color by an own value
track color by an own value with opacity
a track token the theme does not declare: the default track
a track color of a wrong form: the default track
a translucent fill: the track stays under it, the fill is painted over
a fill token the theme does not declare: the default of the field
gradient token, full scale: the stops span the whole scale
gradient token, half of the scale: the WHOLE gradient lies on the filled half
the gradient is stronger than a named color
three stops at 40%: the middle stop is at 20% of the scale; the angle of the token is not read
stops that do not start at 0 and do not end at 1: the first color runs from the start of the scale, the last one to the end of the fill
empty scale with a gradient: every stop is at the start, nothing is drawn
own gradient of color references: tokens and a tint
own gradient of own colors
a gradient token the theme does not declare: the solid color
own gradient with unordered stops is not drawn: the solid color
own gradient with a stop on an unknown color: the solid color, not the gradient without the stop
a gradient of a wrong form (one stop): the solid color

segmentsNote: Schema 9.11.0 — «ProgressBar.segments»: the same scale cut into equal steps. Rules: x-style.layout.progressSegments; policy rows unreadableSegments, segmentsSemantics. The gap between steps is the token xs (4). «states» — one letter per step from the logical start: f — filled, c — current (the first unfilled one), u — unfilled. Widths and starts are not rounded. «expect: null» — the steps are not drawn, the bar is continuous with the same ratio. In a right-to-left language the same numbers are measured from the right edge. «segmentPlaceCases»: the kind of the bar — steps or continuous — is decided by the width the PLACE gives it (`placeInline`), never by its own measure; the own minimum width is the same in both kinds — (segments − 1) × gap — so a bar in a place «by content» does not flip between the kinds on every frame.

segmentCases.name: six steps on a track of 320, half of the scale
the same in a right-to-left language: the first step is on the right
a track of 329: half pixels, nothing is rounded
every step filled: there is no current step
seven steps on 300: a width that is not a whole pixel
a step is filled whole or not at all: two and a half is two
0.3 of 0.4 on four steps is three steps, though the product is 2.9999999999999996
the scale and the steps are different numbers: 50 of 100 on four steps
49 of 100 on four steps: one step
a value above the limit: every step filled
a negative value: nothing filled, the first step is current
a limit of zero is no scale: nothing filled
two steps — the fewest
twelve steps — the most, on a track of 288
a thick bar with narrow steps: the radius is half the SHORTER side
steps narrower than one pixel: the continuous bar
one step is not steps: the continuous bar
thirteen steps — above the bound: the continuous bar
a fractional number of steps: the continuous bar
the number of steps as a string: the continuous bar
no «segments» field: the continuous bar, as before 9.11.0

segmentPlaceCases.name: 336: a stack «by content», 12 steps, gap 4: the bar's own minimum is 44, the step on it is 0, so the bar is continuous — and stays continuous at 44, it does not flip back to steps
336: the place of 55 gives a step of 11/12, less than 1: continuous (the place decides, the bar's own width does not)
336: the place of 56 gives a step of exactly 1: steps
336: six steps by content: the own minimum is 20 in both kinds
336: two steps, the fewest: the own minimum is one gap, a place of 6 gives steps of exactly 1

segmentPaintCases.name: no «currentColor»: the current step looks like every unfilled one
the current step by a token
the current step by a token with opacity
the unfilled steps take the track color
a current color token the theme does not declare: as unfilled
a current color of a wrong form: as unfilled

segmentGradientCases.name: the gradient runs along the filled steps as along one fill: from the start of the first to the end of the last filled
one filled step: the whole gradient inside it
every step filled: the gradient spans the whole track

labelNote: Schema 9.17.0 — the own style of the label of a ring: «CircularProgress.labelTypography» and «labelColor». Rules: x-style.layout.progressLabel. «style» is the style of the node (it gives the diameter and, in one row, proves the label does not inherit). «expect.typography» is the text style the label is drawn with, resolved in «labelTheme»: the token that gives the typeface and the numbers after the overrides; «lineBlock» is fontSize x lineHeight. «expect.color» is the resolved colour. The box of the node is the ring alone: «boxInline» x «boxBlock» never grow with the label. The label is ONE line in the center and is not clipped by the ring.

ringLabelCases.name: no label fields, size sm: the label as before 9.17.0 — caption, onSurface
no label fields, size md
no label fields, size lg
no label fields, a named diameter of 240: the ring grows, the label does NOT (scalesWithDiameter: false)
a text style token, size sm
a text style token, size md
a text style token, size lg
a big ring with a big label: a named diameter of 240 and displayL
a token with overrides: displayL at font size 48, weight 800
only the colour: the font stays caption
a tint of a token
an own colour value
both fields on a named diameter
the label does not size the ring: displayL at 96 in a ring of 48 keeps the box 48 x 48 and is not clipped by the ring
percent: the same style rules
the label does not inherit: colour and typography of the NODE style do not reach it
READER: a text style token the theme does not know — the default (unknown: use-default)
READER: a colour token the theme does not know — the default
READER: fields of a wrong shape — the defaults
READER: an unknown token inside overrides — the default style as a whole, the overrides do not travel to caption

ringLabelNoneCases.name: labelFormat none: the label fields are kept in the document and draw nothing
no labelFormat field at all: nothing is drawn, as before

capNote: Schema 9.21.0 — round ends of a scale: «cap: round» (rules: x-style.layout.progressCap). A ring row: the ratio, the diameter and the thickness in logical pixels; «expected» — what is drawn over the track (none, dot, arc, full), the centres of the ends in degrees from the top clockwise and thetaC in radians. A bar row: the length of the track; «expected» — the length of the fill and the radius of every end. Compare with a tolerance of 1e-6.

capCases.name: ring: nothing filled — nothing over the track
ring: a negative ratio is nothing
ring: a tiny share is a dot of the thickness at thetaC, not a sliver past 0 %
ring: just under two cap angles is still a dot
ring: just over two cap angles is a short arc with two ends
ring: a quarter — square arc between the centres of two round ends
ring: three quarters
ring: almost full — the ends do not meet past 100 %
ring: full — the whole ring, no ends, no seam
ring: over full is full
ring: zero thickness draws nothing
ring: a thick stroke on a small ring
ring: thickness over half of the diameter is clamped to half
bar: nothing filled
bar: a tiny share is a dot of the thickness
bar: half
bar: full
bar: over full is the track
bar: a dot never runs past the track
bar: the radius is half of the thickness, whatever the theme «pill»

segmentFillNote: Schema 9.25.0 — the steps of a bar during a value transition (rules: x-segmentsTransition). «segmentFillCases»: the ratio at the start and at the end of the transition, the eased share e of the curve of x-valueTransition at the moment; «expected» — the number of filled steps with a fraction, the fill of every step (0 to 1, from the logical start) and the current step (the first one not full; null — every step is full). At rest (e = 1, or no transition) the steps are whole, as in 9.11. «segmentFillInlineCases» — the length of the gradient line along the drawn fill for a step of «step» and a gap of «gap» logical pixels. «transitionShareCases» — the eased share recovered from the shown value of the scale. Compare with a tolerance of 1e-9.

segmentFillCases.name: appear 4 of 6: the first frame is empty
appear 4 of 6 halfway along the curve: two whole steps
appear 4 of 6 at e = 0.875: the fourth step is half filled
appear 4 of 6 at the end: whole steps at rest
the end is a picture at rest: 0.55 of 6 grows to three steps, not 3.3
0.55 of 6 halfway: one and a half steps
a change inside one step moves nothing
a step forward: the next step fills smoothly
down: the steps empty from the end
to full: no current step at the end
the precision of 9.11 at both ends: 0.3 of 10 is three steps
the eased share is clamped to 0…1

segmentFillInlineCases.name: two whole steps: one gap inside
three and a half: three gaps
a quarter of the first step: no gap

transitionShareCases.name: equal ends — the transition is over
past the end stays at the end
before the start stays at the start

glowNote: Schema 9.25.0 — the glow of a scale: «glow: soft | strong» on ProgressBar and CircularProgress (rules: x-progressGlow). «glowStepCases»: which step of a bar with steps glows — «fills» are the fills of the steps (0 to 1), «currentPainted» says whether «currentColor» is there and resolves; «expected.kind» is «current» (the whole step glows in currentColor), «front» (the drawn part of the last step with any fill glows in the fill paint, «fill» is its share) or «none». «glowRuleCases» — keys of x-progressGlow.

glowStepCases.name: at rest, 3 of 6, no current colour: the last filled step
at rest, 3 of 6, a current colour: the current step
everything filled, a current colour: no current step, the last filled glows
nothing filled, no current colour: no glow
nothing filled, a current colour: the first step glows in it
during a transition, no current colour: the step that is filling
during a transition, a current colour: the step that is filling is the current one

glowRuleCases.name: read on the bar and the ring
